title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Occidental College
description: Ten under-21-safe campus and Northeast Los Angeles stops with late hours verified on direct operator or college pages.

cards.title: Tiger Cooler
cards.subtitle: Samuelson Alumni Center, Occidental College
cards.notes: Use the on-campus option when you need a late snack or meal. Check the college dining page for academic-year and holiday-hour changes.
cards.short_summary: Oxy’s latest regular on-campus dining option.
cards.evidence_claim: Occidental lists the Tiger Cooler open until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday/holidays; its grill closes at 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours: until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday/holidays; grill closes 10:30 p.m. Hours may vary during breaks.

cards.title: Seaside Burritos + Tacos
cards.subtitle: 1958 Colorado Blvd, Eagle Rock
cards.notes: Plan a pickup or dine-in stop on Colorado Boulevard. The restaurant’s location page lists the same late closing time every day.
cards.short_summary: Colorado Boulevard burritos and tacos until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Seaside Burritos + Tacos lists its Eagle Rock location at 1958 Colorado Blvd as open 9 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dining, pickup, and delivery 9 a.m.–2 a.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Del Taco — 4903 N Eagle Rock Blvd
cards.title: Del Taco on Eagle Rock Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4903 N Eagle Rock Blvd, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the day’s closing time before leaving. It lists midnight most days and 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A nearby drive-thru option with midnight-or-later hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco lists this 4903 N Eagle Rock Blvd location open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Del Taco in Los Angeles, California
cards.access_notes: Official store hours: midnight Sunday–Thursday; 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 4470 Eagle Rock Blvd
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Eagle Rock Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4470 Eagle Rock Blvd, Eagle Rock
cards.notes: For very late food, use the drive-thru rather than assuming the lobby is open. The operator lists the lobby closing substantially earlier.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru listed through 4 a.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists its drive-thru at 4470 Eagle Rock Blvd as open until 4 a.m. daily, while lobby hours end at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 4470 Eagle Rock Blvd
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 4 a.m. daily; lobby is listed 6 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Colorado Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1734 W Colorado Blvd, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Check the drive-thru schedule before heading out; it stays open later than the dine-in room and reaches 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Colorado Boulevard drive-thru service through midnight or 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 1734 W Colorado Blvd until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Original Ave 26 Tacos
cards.subtitle: 1033 Neola St, Eagle Rock
cards.notes: Make this an earlier late-evening stop rather than a post-midnight plan. The business’s own site lists its Eagle Rock schedule as 5–11 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: An Eagle Rock taco stand listed until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Original Ave 26 Tacos lists its Eagle Rock location at 1033 Neola St open Monday–Sunday from 5 p.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Eagle Rock hours as 5 p.m.–11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on Colorado Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1910 Colorado Blvd, Eagle Rock
cards.notes: Use this 24/7 store for convenience items or hot food when restaurant kitchens are closed. Confirm in-store availability when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A Colorado Boulevard convenience stop open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its store at 1910 Colorado Blvd in Eagle Rock as open 24/7 and identifies hot foods among its store features.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on North Figueroa
cards.subtitle: 5138 N Figueroa St, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Use this Highland Park-area stop for a late convenience run. The official page lists hot foods and says the store is open 24/7.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 North Figueroa convenience stop with hot foods.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its location at 5138 N Figueroa St as open 24/7 and includes hot foods in the store features.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on North San Fernando Road
cards.subtitle: 2205 N San Fernando Rd, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Keep this as a round-the-clock backup for convenience purchases. The official location page provides the address and explicitly states it is open 24/7.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 San Fernando Road convenience backup.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its location at 2205 N San Fernando Rd in Los Angeles as open 24/7.

cards.title: Shell C-Store on Eagle Rock Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4236 Eagle Rock Blvd, Los Angeles
cards.notes: Use the attached convenience store for a late essentials run. The station’s official listing identifies a C-Store and lists 24-hour operation.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Eagle Rock Boulevard station with a convenience store.
cards.evidence_claim: Shell lists 4236 Eagle Rock Blvd as open 24 hours and states that the station includes a C-Store.
cards.access_notes: Official Shell listing says “Open 24 Hours” and gives forecourt hours of 00:00–23:59 daily.
